title: Exodus wallet vault
whyItMatters: The Exodus folder holds the encrypted vault with the private keys for all of the person's coins. With the password it is the money; without it, it still proves what they owned.
source: Exodus Knowledge Base: on Linux the data folder is ~/.config/Exodus (Developer > Data Folder opens it): https://www.exodus.com/support/en/articles/8598644-how-do-i-delete-my-wallet-and-start-over
notes: exodus.wallet holds the encrypted storage.seco files; the Backups folder keeps timestamped copies of earlier vaults, so the parent folder matters too. The vault is encrypted with the wallet password and the 12-word phrase.
